city.body: Tushar Sharma, a resident of Surrey, was discovered dead in a burning vehicle on October 29. Firefighters located human remains while extinguishing the fire in Langley, British Columbia. The Integrated Homicide Investigation Team is investigating the case for potential motives and contacts. Police believe Sharma was specifically targeted despite his limited criminal background and acquaintances. Investigators request public assistance with information and any related CCTV or dashcam footage.

city.title: 'Responsibility to banish hatred': Mamdani condemns anti-Indian racism at Diwali event
city.body: Mayor Zohran Mamdani addressed rising incidents of racism targeting the Indian-American community during a Diwali celebration. He emphasized the need for collective responsibility in combating hate and ensuring safety for Hindus and Sikhs. Thirteen US lawmakers have requested a federal investigation into a disruption of a Diwali event in Seattle. They referred to troubling patterns of anti-South Asian hate across the country.

city.body: Los Angeles City Council recognized Diwali and honored Consul General Dr KJ Srinivasa for his community contributions. A resolution was passed to extend Diwali greetings to residents across Los Angeles. Both Dr Srinivasa and Mayor Nithya Raman committed to strengthening ties between India and Los Angeles.
